title: Creative Commons License Chooser
description: Deterministic decision tree mapping creator answers (waive rights? commercial? adaptations?) to the matching Creative Commons license family (CC0, CC BY, BY-SA, BY-ND, BY-NC, BY-NC-SA, BY-NC-ND) with SPDX id, canonical deed URL, and attribution requirement. Recreates the CC chooser as a verifiable, agent-callable step for content licensing before tokenization. Selection only, not legal advice. Zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: cc_license_chooser
mcp_tool_definition.description: Maps creator answers (waive all rights, allow commercial use, allow adaptations/share-alike) to the matching Creative Commons license (CC0, CC BY, BY-SA, BY-ND, BY-NC, BY-NC-SA, BY-NC-ND) with SPDX id, canonical deed URL and attribution requirement. Deterministic decision tree. Use when a creator or agent needs to pick a standard CC license before licensing or tokenizing content. Selection only, not legal advice.

allow_adaptations.description: Allow adaptations (none adds NoDerivatives, share_alike adds ShareAlike)
